entries.zh: 房；房屋、房间（任意一间住所）
entries.en: room; house, apartment, any chamber

entries.zh: 房间；房舍内的一间
entries.en: room, chamber

entries.zh: 间；房屋的间隔、一间（兼作量词）
entries.en: room, compartment; measure word for rooms

entries.zh: 后堂；官邸后堂，官吏接待来宾之处
entries.en: rear hall; the mandarin's back hall where he receives the visit

entries.zh: 五凤楼；皇后梳妆之楼阁
entries.en: Wufeng lou, Five-Phoenix tower; the tower where the queen combs her hair

entries.zh: 深宫；皇后与国王言语之内的宫室
entries.en: inner palace, the deep palace where the queen speaks with the king

entries.zh: 寅宾馆；官府迎宾款客之馆
entries.en: guesthouse for receiving visitors (yinbin guan), lodging of guests

entries.zh: 绣房；女子做针线刺绣之所
entries.en: embroidery room, women's needlework chamber

entries.zh: 长房；长子所居之房
entries.en: the eldest son's apartment

entries.zh: 赌；赌博、下注
entries.en: to gamble, to wager, to bet

entries.zh: 赌过；已经赌过
entries.en: to have already gambled, bet

entries.zh: 赌赔；下注押赔（赌局中押注认赔）；汉字有异说
entries.en: to stake and stand to lose/win at a wager; to bet in a game
entries.notes: 封存件标注〔疑:賠/貯〕，第二字有异说，按音写与词头义定为赌赔。

entries.zh: 相赌；互相打赌、赌输赢
entries.en: to wager with one another, bet against each other

entries.zh: 相输；互相较量输赢（相赌见输）
entries.en: to contend at a wager, match oneself and lose; mutual contest of winning and losing
entries.notes: 西语词头仅作 apostar，与汉字相输的搭配略宽，按音写与上下文（赌输赢组）释之。

entries.zh: 相吓；互相吓唬、以赌相吓
entries.en: to frighten one another, to bluff or dare at a wager
entries.notes: 西语词头 apostar 与汉字相吓语义有出入，按音写与汉字定为相吓，赌义为次要。

entries.zh: 相帮；互相帮衬（汉字有异说）
entries.en: to help one another, back each other in a wager
entries.notes: 封存件标注〔疑:幫/封〕，且闽南音写仅存单音节，第二字缺。

entries.zh: 帮大家输赢；替人押注、代众人赌输赢（汉字有异说）
entries.en: to stake for the whole company, wager on anyone's winning or losing
entries.notes: 封存件标注〔疑:幫/憑〕；西语义为押注任凭谁人得胜，与四栏大体相合。

entries.zh: 做谜；出谜猜谜，凭猜卜断
entries.en: to make a riddle, guess by divination (as at a novena)
entries.notes: 西语词头谓猜度以为是九日敬礼，与汉字做谜的组合需依语境推断。

entries.zh: 〔原件存疑，释义未定〕；西语词头指肿胀、鼻塞之症
entries.en: uncertain; Spanish headword glosses apostemado (swollen, abscessed), opilado (stuffed at the nose)
entries.notes: 封存件标注〔疑:賬/相〕，汉字与西语病理义不能互证，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 估；估价、估量
entries.en: to appraise, estimate, value

entries.zh: 估定价；定价、按则估价
entries.en: to fix a price by appraisal, set the tariff

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕；西语词头义为认可、核准
entries.en: fragmentary; Spanish headword aprobar = to approve, sanction
entries.notes: 汉字栏〔空〕、官话对音栏〔空〕，仅存闽南音写，无法与汉字互证。
